title: The Sun of Righteousness and the Coming of Elijah
description: The prophecy concerns the burning day of judgment, where the arrogant and unrighteous will be like chaff, while the Sun of Righteousness rises with healing in its wings for those who fear the name of the Lord. The righteous shall tread down the unrighteous, who will become as ashes. The message concludes with an exhortation to remember the Law of Moses given at Horeb, and a promise that the prophet Elijah will be sent before the great and dreadful day of the Lord to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers.
